planId.description: A unique identifier for the proposed plan (e.g., a UUID).

equipmentId.description: The identifier of the equipment or asset the plan applies to.

description.description: A brief, descriptive title for the maintenance plan.

frequency.description: How often the maintenance should be performed.

tasks.description: A list of individual maintenance actions.

requiredSkills.description: List of required technician skills (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical).
